deal_outcome: closed_lost - customer elected to build self-hosted stack (vLLM + TGI + TensorRT-LLM) on their infra to reduce per-token costs and gain full KMS/control
notes:
Procurement track — originally engaged May 2024. POC demo in July (chat + document search). Heavy technical diligence in Aug-Sep: security sent long questionnaire; infra team insisted on customer-managed KMS and network isolation. Pricing sensitivity flagged early: wants predictable unit economics for high-query support center. 

Meeting highlights: 
- 2024-06-18 initial intro (ff_2024-06-18_halcyon_intro): good product fit for knowledge-grounding and agent routing. AE: Maya. SE: Diego. "Their main concern is cost at scale and being able to control vector DB locality," said Head of ML.
- 2024-07-22 demo: streamed chat demo, embeddings latencies within targets but they wanted on-prem latency guarantees.
- 2024-09-12 security review (ff_2024-09-12_security_review): security team pushed back on hosted KMS and long-term retention controls — requested audit logs, per-tenant access controls, and support for HSM-backed keys.
- 2024-10-03 internal decision: infra voted to prototype self-host using vLLM (LLM serving), TGI for orchestration, and TensorRT-LLM for optimized A100 inference. They ran a small performance test on A100 nodes and saw ~40% lower cost per 1M tokens vs hosted quotes.

Other notes: no clear executive champion to secure budget for Redwood Dedicated. Primary blocker became a combination of cost modeling and security preference for customer-managed KMS + strict data residency. Sales last attempted to re-open in mid-Oct with an alternative dedicated pricing path + extended POC — no response. Marking closed-lost but keep observable/optimize upsell in CRM for Q1 outreach.
